before.command: curl -fsSL https://deno.land/install.sh | sh && export DENO_INSTALL="$HOME/.deno" && export PATH="$DENO_INSTALL/bin:$PATH"

diagnosis.cause: README.md:579 documents `deno add axios` but Deno v2 requires an explicit registry specifier; the correct command is `deno add npm:axios` (bare names without `npm:` or `jsr:` prefix are not valid Deno package specifiers and exit with code 35).

doc.text: Replace `deno add axios` with `deno add npm:axios` at README.md:579 so the Deno specifier is valid for Deno v2.
